stories.headline: OpenAI Says 10,000 Coordinating Agents Cracked Navier-Stokes in 88 Hours. Mathematicians Get the Final Word.
stories.key_takeaway: OpenAI says a swarm of about 10,000 agents produced a Lean-formalized proof that Navier-Stokes solutions can blow up in finite time, but independent mathematicians have not yet confirmed the formal statement matches the Clay Institute's criteria, and a priority dispute with NYU's Tristan Buckmaster is unresolved.

pull_quote.text: It is not the direction one arrives at in a few days by giving a model the problem statement.

stories.article_excerpt: On the morning of Tuesday, September 8, a swarm of roughly 10,000 autonomous agents produced what OpenAI calls a proof.

stories.headline: Meta Launches Muse, a Personal AI Agent Spanning Web, Phones and WhatsApp
stories.key_takeaway: Meta launched Muse, a personal AI agent that acts on users' behalf across web, iOS, Android and WhatsApp with a free tier plus $20 and $100 monthly plans, betting consumers will grant it access to their email, calendars and payments despite the company's privacy record.

pull_quote.text: For the vast majority of users, they should be able to do what they need to within the free tier. But for real power users, those subscription tiers help us cover the compute costs.

stories.article_excerpt: Meta on Tuesday introduced Muse, a personal AI agent that can send emails, book travel, negotiate bills and buy things on a user's behalf.

stories.headline: NSA, CISA and FBI Name Six Chinese AI Firms in an Industrial-Scale Distillation Alert
stories.key_takeaway: US agencies publicly named six Chinese AI firms over alleged industrial-scale distillation of American frontier models, but the advisory alleges only terms-of-use violations and stops short of calling the conduct illegal.

pull_quote.text: But if every TOS violation counts as theft, then the concept has no limiting principle.
pull_quote.role: Senior Research Scholar, Institute for Law and AI

stories.article_excerpt: American AI labs complained privately for years that Chinese competitors were farming their models. On Tuesday the accusation became official.

stories.headline: DeepMind Precomputed Every One of 9 Billion Possible DNA Letter Changes. It Fills a Petabyte.
stories.key_takeaway: DeepMind precomputed AlphaGenome predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter human DNA changes into a 1-petabyte open research database, shifting the bottleneck from computation to laboratory validation.

pull_quote.text: It has a clear use, but it also is probably going to be easily misinterpreted.

stories.article_excerpt: Google DeepMind has done to the human genome what it once did to the protein universe: run the model on everything, in advance.

stories.headline: Lightfield Raises $47M Series A Led by a16z for an AI-Native Customer System
stories.key_takeaway: Lightfield, the Tome team's pivot into an AI-native CRM, raised $47M led by a16z on a bet that agents fail because of the CRM data model itself, not the models.

pull_quote.text: Every platform shift produces a new system of record. Salesforce defined it for the cloud era, and Lightfield is defining it for the agent era.

stories.article_excerpt: The team that built Tome, the AI presentation tool that racked up more than 20 million users, is back with a CRM.

stories.headline: Savvy Wealth Raises $100M Series C at $600M as AI Reshapes the Advisor's Desk
stories.key_takeaway: Savvy Wealth's $100M Series C at a $600M valuation bets that AI agents can deliver the scale benefits of an RIA rollup without forcing advisors to sell their equity.

pull_quote.text: Wealth management is a $14 trillion market, and the technology underneath it hasn't meaningfully changed in decades.

stories.article_excerpt: Fifteen months ago, Savvy Wealth carried a private valuation of roughly $90 million. On Tuesday it announced a $600 million one.

stories.headline: Runway's ARR Doubled to $200M Since April as It Pushes Past Video Into Robotics
stories.key_takeaway: Runway doubled ARR to $200 million in five months on enterprise model licensing, and is using the momentum to reposition from an AI video tool into a world-model company selling robotics simulation.

pull_quote.text: Robotics is going to be one of the biggest applications of world models, and it's an area we're deeply focused on.

stories.article_excerpt: Runway crossed $200 million in annual recurring revenue in early September, roughly doubling its top line in five months.

stories.headline: XPeng Fires Up Its IRON Humanoid Line in Guangzhou With 2,250 TOPS Onboard
stories.key_takeaway: XPeng has switched on an 80%-automated humanoid production line in Guangzhou, moving IRON from stage demo to manufacturing ahead of year-end mass production and 2027 deliveries.

pull_quote.text: The robot production lines were created from scratch with no precedent to follow. Today's step is small, but XPeng is building the production lines for an entirely new product category.

stories.article_excerpt: A humanoid robot walked off an assembly line in Guangzhou on Tuesday under its own power, and the line is the news.

stories.headline: India's National Quantum Mission Anchors QNu Labs' 200 Crore Rupee Round
stories.key_takeaway: India's National Quantum Mission co-led a 200 crore rupee ($21M) Series A1 into QNu Labs, making the state an equity holder in the quantum-safe cryptography stack protecting its own defence, government and banking networks.

pull_quote.text: Quantum-safe security is becoming national infrastructure, as essential to a digital economy as power and transport are to a physical one.
pull_quote.role: Co-founder and Managing Partner, Gaja Capital

stories.article_excerpt: Bengaluru's QNu Labs said on September 9 it had raised 200 crore rupees, roughly $21 million, with the state as co-lead.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Opens a V4.1 Flash Endpoint That Expires in a Day, Claims It Beats V4 Pro Outright
stories.key_takeaway: DeepSeek opened a self-expiring V4.1 Flash test endpoint and says the small model comprehensively beats its 1.6T-parameter V4 Pro flagship, but has published no benchmark table, parameter count or model card to back it.

pull_quote.text: That is the claim to test on September 10, and it is DeepSeek's claim, from its own internal and external runs, not ours.

data_points.label: Cut to off-peak cached input price

stories.article_excerpt: The model told you when it would die before it told you what it was. DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash endpoint came with an expiry date.

stories.headline: OpenAI Ships ChatGPT Images 2.5, Five Months After 2.0
stories.key_takeaway: ChatGPT Images 2.5 competes on edit persistence and workflow lock-in rather than raw fidelity, shipping to all tiers with two API variants and a claimed latency cut as rivals converge on output quality.

pull_quote.text: I don't want to be able to see ChatGPT in the world. I want people to be able to generate and express their own individualism.

stories.article_excerpt: Five months after ChatGPT Images 2.0 landed, OpenAI shipped its successor, and the pitch is no longer about fidelity.

stories.headline: xAI Ships Grok Bot for Enterprise as It Chases Seats Instead of Attention
stories.key_takeaway: xAI's Grok Bot for Enterprise gives admins org-wide deployment plus network, access and audit controls, but permissive defaults and an unresolved brand-trust problem mean the compliance checklist is complete while the enterprise business is not.

pull_quote.text: For enterprise buyers, the issue is not infrastructure. It is optics.
pull_quote.role: Principal Research Director, Info-Tech Research Group

data_points.label: Per user per month, Grok Business

stories.article_excerpt: xAI spent two years teaching the internet to argue about Grok. Now it is asking IT administrators to deploy it.

stories.headline: A Fields Medalist Is Building an Institute for Mathematical AI Safety
stories.key_takeaway: 2026 Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman launched MAISI, an independent institute that plans to put 10 to 30 mathematicians in residence by January 2027 and up to 100 by September 2027 to build formal foundations for AI safety, though it has disclosed no funding sources.

pull_quote.text: A central reason the safety of powerful AI systems remains in question is that we lack a rigorous understanding of what it would mean to be safe, even in theory.

stories.article_excerpt: Six weeks after collecting the highest honor in mathematics, Jacob Tsimerman went looking for a harder problem.

stories.headline: AutoSOTA Automates the Hunt for State of the Art. The Bottleneck Was Never the Search.
stories.key_takeaway: Tsinghua's AutoSOTA beat the published numbers on 105 of 125 top-conference papers in about five hours each, but its own guardrail agent failed to catch invalid, metric-gaming optimizations in 16 percent of cases.

pull_quote.text: In practice, our early experiments reveal that these behaviors occur more frequently than anticipated in autonomous optimization settings.

stories.article_excerpt: A team at Tsinghua pointed a swarm of eight AI agents at 125 papers from last year's top machine learning conferences.

stories.headline: Frontier Labs Have Days Left to File Their First Systemic Risk Reports in Brussels
stories.key_takeaway: The EU AI Office's first round of compelled systemic risk filings from frontier labs lands September 15, but with roughly 165 staff and no published evaluation methodology, its ability to actually audit what arrives is the open question.

pull_quote.text: The tools are on the table. The question is whether anyone picks them up.
pull_quote.role: Fellow, Harvard Kennedy School, writing in Lawfare

stories.article_excerpt: Five days from now, the European AI Office expects to receive something no regulator anywhere has ever collected.

stories.headline: An Anthropic Researcher Resigned This Week. His Reasons Are the Story.
stories.key_takeaway: Jacob Coxon quit Anthropic after four months with zero vested equity, giving his warning about recursive self-improvement unusual credibility while also limiting how much he actually observed from the inside.

pull_quote.text: Jacob is correct here. We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans. I personally think it is greater than 10% within the next decade.

stories.article_excerpt: Jacob Coxon walked away from Anthropic four months into the job, two months before a single share would have vested.
